verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਤ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਸੁਤ ਪੋਖਤ ਸ-ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਹਸਤ ਬਿਹਸਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise maataa pitaa na beechaarat bikaar sut pokhat sa-prem bihasat bihasai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as the parents take no notice of the faults of their son and bring him up in happy and pleasant atmosphere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾਵੰਤ ਜੰਤ ਬੈਦਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਤਾਂਤ ਕਹੈ ਪਰਖ ਪਰੀਖਾ ਉਪਚਾਰਤ ਰਸਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise birathaava(n)t ja(n)t baidheh birataa(n)t kahai parakh pareekhaa upachaarat rasai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as a patient suffering from pain explains his ailment to the physician, ignoring his carelessness in maintaining his health, the physician administers medicine lovingly after thorough investigation,

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਟੀਆ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਏਕ ਚਟਿਸਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਦਿਆ-ਵੰਤ ਕਰੇ ਪਾਂਧਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਸੈ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਇ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: chaTeeaa anek jaise ek chaTisaar bikhai bidhiaa-va(n)t kare paa(n)dhaa preet sai paRhai kai ||

en.bdb: Just as there are many students in a school, the teacher does not look into their childish pranks and nuisance but teaches them devotedly to make them knowledgeable,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ-ਸਿਖਨ ਕੈ ਅਉਗੁਨ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸੈ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਝਾਇ ਕੈ ॥੩੭੮॥
verses.translit_en: taise gura-sikhan kai aaugun agiaan meTai braham bibek sai sahaj samajhai kai ||378||

en.bdb: So does the True Guru bless the Sikhs in His refuge with divine knowledge and high state of equipoise, thus obliterating their ill deeds performed in ignorance.  (378)
